title: Oracle: a triggered integrated update stayed RUNNING while lag grew

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3, one probe row, one run

symptom: RUNNING for 23 minutes. Lag 232 s at 5 min, 538 s at 11, 898 s at 17, 1258 s at 23, with no source changes after one probe row. "Will stop once the lag converges"; no COMPLETED event.
cause: Not established: a backlog from setup, or a lag measure that counts idle time.
effect: A triggered update doesn't end when expected.
fix: Watch a longer run with a steady trickle of changes; record the lag over time before stopping it.
